title: Monopoly Was Invented to WARN You About Landlords 🎲 #shorts
description:
In 1904 Lizzie Magie patented The Landlord's Game to show how landlords get rich from rent. Decades later Charles Darrow sold a copy as Monopoly, and Parker Brothers bought her patent for just $500.
Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Lizzie G. Magie"; Smithsonian Magazine, "A New Monopoly Celebrates Women..." (2019); NPR, "Ever Cheat At Monopoly? So Did Its Creator" (2015). Education, not financial advice.
script: Monopoly was invented to warn you about landlords. Not to make you one.
In nineteen oh four, a woman named Lizzie Magie patented The Landlord's Game.
Her point was simple. Owners collect rent, while everyone else slowly goes broke.
People loved it. They copied it and passed it around for decades.
Then a man named Charles Darrow sold a version as his own invention.
Parker Brothers made it a hit. And Lizzie? They bought her patent for just five hundred dollars.
A game about greed became a lesson in greed.
So next time you play, remember who the game was warning you about.
